Container.Name: romm-sync
Container.Overview: Keeps emulator saves and save states in a Syncthing folder in sync with RomM, both ways. Web dashboard shows sync progress per system and game (with RomM covers and state screenshots), asks before uploading new files or pulling from RomM, and lets you resolve conflicts side by side. Fork of romm_syncthing_sync by amn-96 (MIT).
Container.Requires: A running RomM instance (4.5+, 5.x recommended) and a folder of saves/states, e.g. synced by Syncthing.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Dashboard port

Config.Name: Saves folder
Config.Description: Saves (.srm, .sav…), one subfolder per system. Use 'ro' only if PULL_MODE=off.

Config.Name: States folder
Config.Description: Save states (.state*, .state*.png), one subfolder per system.

Config.Name: App data
Config.Description: Sync history, pending approvals and backups of overwritten files.

Config.Name: RomM URL
Config.Description: Address of your RomM instance

Config.Name: RomM auth type
Config.Description: api = Client API token (recommended), http = username/password

Config.Name: RomM API token
Config.Description: RomM → profile → Client API Tokens. Needs assets read/write and roms/platforms read.

Config.Name: RomM username
Config.Description: Only for http auth

Config.Name: RomM password
Config.Description: Only for http auth

Config.Name: Sync mode
Config.Description: watch = react to file changes (and poll RomM), periodic = full sync every SYNC_INTERVAL_SECONDS

Config.Name: New local files → RomM
Config.Description: auto = upload right away (you're still asked when something is unclear), confirm = approve every new file

Config.Name: RomM → folder sync
Config.Description: Download saves/states that are new or newer on RomM. auto = right away (you're still asked when something is unclear)

Config.Name: RomM poll interval (s)
Config.Description: Watch mode: how often to check RomM for changes made elsewhere. 0 = only on Sync now

Config.Name: Watch delay (s)
Config.Description: Watch mode: wait for this long without file activity before syncing

Config.Name: Periodic interval (s)
Config.Description: Periodic mode: seconds between full syncs

Config.Name: Full initial sync
Config.Description: Run a full sync when the container starts

Config.Name: Force push
Config.Description: Always overwrite RomM with local files, even on conflicts. Dangerous.

Config.Name: Backup retention (days)
Config.Description: Backups of overwritten files are kept this long. 0 = forever

Config.Name: Dashboard username
Config.Description: Optional basic auth for the web UI

Config.Name: Dashboard password
Config.Description: Optional basic auth for the web UI

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: Owner of files written to the sync folders

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group of files written to the sync folders

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Used for log timestamps

Config.Name: SAVE_SYNC_FOLDER
Config.Description: Internal: enables the saves mount. Leave as is.

Config.Name: STATE_SYNC_FOLDER
Config.Description: Internal: enables the states mount. Leave as is.
